audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart shows Skill for levels 1-6 while the content layer and packet both show Ahri winning levels 1-6; the two layers render different answers.
audit.why: Packet levelChart and content win[] agree: Ahri, Ahri, Ahri, Ahri, Ahri, Ryze, Ryze. Ahri's 970-range Orb and 975-range Charm outrange Ryze's 1000/615 kit in practice because her poke is safe and his requires wave contact; Spirit Rush at 6 dodges the root.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; several fields misgender Ahri; missingInteractions flag Essence Theft sustain (anti-heal timing) and Orb's true-damage return invalidating MR stacking, neither on the page.
audit.why: Kit file: Charm 12s flat, Spirit Rush 140/120/100, Ryze W 11s rank 1, Q 5s reset by other spells. Ahri P heals off minion kills; Q return is true damage.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with real numbers; pronouns fixed throughout; enemyWin now states the Charm+true-damage-return pattern. Anti-heal/resistance notes recorded for the user (no natural slot within length band).

notes: Packet suspectName on wants.foe[1] 'Use Spirit Rush' is a FALSE POSITIVE — Spirit Rush is Ahri's real R name per the kit; left as-is. Level chart fixed on the full layer only: content win[0..4] already read 'Ahri', so per the chart rule side/rating/why moved alone with no no-op win[] edits. Missing interactions I could not fit inside the length band: (1) Essence Theft (P) heals Ahri off every 9th minion — extended-trade attrition favours her more than the page implies; if an anti-heal slot is ever added to report[8] itemization it belongs there. (2) Orb of Deception's return is TRUE damage, so stacking MR early is a partially wrong answer — dodging the return matters more than resists. Recorded rather than forced into fields where they would break the band. report[7].t 'him' referred to Ryze (owner), lint flagged it anyway; reworded to avoid pronoun ambiguity and removed the unsourced 'doubles' magnitude.
